tools.name: analyze_sequence
tools.description: Analyze a DNA, RNA, or protein sequence (length, type, validity, reverse complement for DNA). Research use only.

tools.name: fold_protein
tools.description: Predict 3D protein structure from amino acid sequence (ESMFold via HF or local fold URL). Writes PDB under the configured biology artifacts folder.

sequence.description: Amino acid sequence or FASTA (protein only)

tools.name: structure_metadata
tools.description: Summarize a PDB/mmCIF file: atom count, chains, mean B-factor.

path.description: Absolute or workspace path to structure file

tools.name: blast_search
tools.description: Submit a BLAST query via the biology sidecar (NCBI REST). Research use only.

tools.name: pathway_lookup
tools.description: Look up pathways for a gene name or symbol via Reactome (read-only).

tools.name: validate_smiles
tools.description: Validate and canonicalize a SMILES string (requires RDKit in biology sidecar; set INSTALL_RDKIT=1).

tools.name: mol_descriptors
tools.description: Compute basic molecular descriptors for a SMILES string (requires RDKit).
